results.title: Unknown CLI arguments start the full pipeline
results.recommendation: Add explicit argument parsing before calling main(): allow no arguments for normal operation, allow documented status/help flags, and reject all other arguments with a nonzero exit before any startup side effects. Prefer a small pure parser so behavior can be tested without starting the pipeline.
results.reproduction: Run the command with an unrecognized argument such as `buster-pipeline --help` or `buster-pipeline --bogus`; it will enter `main()` rather than printing usage or exiting nonzero.
results.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests were included for this feature, and the current entrypoint has no pure argument parser that would make unknown-argument behavior easy to assert.
results.suggestedRegressionTest: Add an entrypoint argument parsing test that passes `['node','buster-pipeline.ts','--bogus']` and asserts that main is not invoked and the result is a nonzero usage error; add a second test that no extra args invokes normal startup.
results.minimumFixScope: buster/buster-pipeline.ts

results.title: Unvalidated push branch can be interpreted as git options or invalid refspecs
results.recommendation: Validate branch before any gitExec call: require a non-empty branch name, reject names starting with `-`, reject whitespace/control characters, reject `..`, `@{`, trailing `.`, lockfile suffixes, leading slash, repeated slashes, and other invalid git ref components; ideally verify with `git check-ref-format --branch <branch>` and additionally reject option-looking values before invoking git.
results.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests are included for gitPushWithRetry, and the type declaration only constrains branch to `string`, so invalid or option-like branch inputs are not exercised.
results.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a git-workflows unit test that calls gitPushWithRetry with invalid branches such as `''`, `--force`, and `topic with space`, asserting it rejects before invoking pull or push; add a positive case for a normal branch name.
results.minimumFixScope: Add a local branch/ref validation helper in buster/pipeline/services/git-workflows.ts and call it at the start of gitPushWithRetry.

results.title: Visual-reg log sinks are shared globally during async runs
results.recommendation: Make log a per-run closure that captures ctx.logSink and pass it into helper functions, or save and restore the previous sink in a try/finally while avoiding shared state across concurrent runs.
results.reproduction: Start two runVisualReg calls concurrently with different logSink functions and delay one screenshot batch; logs emitted after the second call starts will use the second sink regardless of which run produced them.
results.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests were included, and sequential suite tests would not expose cross-run sink overwrites.
results.suggestedRegressionTest: Run two visual-reg contexts concurrently with separate collecting sinks and mocked screenshot/Discord functions; assert each sink receives only its own module's log entries.
results.minimumFixScope: Remove the module-level _logSink dependency for runVisualReg and thread a per-invocation logger through runMultiPath and Discord delivery options.

results.title: Worker exceptions after dispatch leave active_agent persisted
results.recommendation: In each catch path, load the latest status, clearModuleActiveAgent, save the cleared status, and preserve correlation fields from the dispatched session. Prefer a finally/finalization helper around worker execution so all post-dispatch exits clear lifecycle state exactly once.
results.reproduction: Use a fake worker handler that invokes workerInput.onDispatched with a session_key and then throws. The catch path returns EXIT_ERROR, but the saved module status still contains active_agent from onDispatched.
results.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No worker lifecycle tests were included, and the failure requires a callback-then-throw sequence that typechecks do not model.
results.suggestedRegressionTest: Add Forge and Buster fake-worker tests that call onDispatched then throw, asserting the terminal error is returned and saved status.active_agent is absent.
results.minimumFixScope: Update the Forge and Buster worker catch handling paths.

results.title: CLI may truncate machine-readable JSON by forcing process exit

results.suggestedRegressionTest: Spawn the CLI with a mocked read-completion response large enough to exercise stdout buffering and assert the captured stdout is complete valid JSON across repeated runs.

results.title: sanitizeForJson corrupts repeated array references as circular
results.recommendation: Balance seen.add with seen.delete for arrays, ideally with try/finally around both array and object traversal so repeated references are not mistaken for cycles after traversal completes.

decisions.decision: Real cleanup retry bug. Failed session termination can be marked cleaned and never retried.
decisions.fix_direction: Track termination and untracking separately and retry failed cleanup operations.

decisions.decision: Real plugin artifact path traversal bug. Lane segments can allow dot-dot traversal.
decisions.fix_direction: Reject dot-only path segments and assert resolved artifact paths remain under plugin-artifacts root.

decisions.decision: Real prompt boundary bug. Operator remediation prompt can escape its XML-like fence.
decisions.fix_direction: Escape or encode prompt content before embedding in operator_remediation_directive.

decisions.decision: Real task-scope cleanup bug. Task cleanup can affect global nginx and shared sandbox outputs.
decisions.fix_direction: Restrict task-scoped cleanup to task-labeled resources and reserve global cleanup for startup/shutdown.

decisions.decision: Real telemetry data-loss bug. Tool/model end reasons are overwritten by outcomes.
decisions.fix_direction: Preserve reason from payload.reason and keep outcome as a separate field.

decisions.decision: Real git ref safety bug. Unvalidated push branch can be interpreted as options or invalid refspecs.
decisions.fix_direction: Validate branch/ref names before git calls, rejecting option-looking and invalid refs.

decisions.decision: Real Redis completion selection bug. Malformed ignored-source completions can override canonical completions.
decisions.fix_direction: Filter/classify trusted current sources before fatal schema adjudication.

decisions.decision: Real local evidence watcher bug. Target creation under a missing parent can be missed.
decisions.fix_direction: Treat ancestor-of-target events as relevant and re-check or re-arm watcher specs.

decisions.decision: Real health monitor lifecycle bug. Gateway health monitor cannot be cancelled because it drops the interval handle.
decisions.fix_direction: Return the setInterval handle so callers can clear it.

decisions.decision: Real facade export contract bug. Discord fields facade exports the contract module instead of implementation.
decisions.fix_direction: Re-export the canonical common Discord fields implementation from the Buster facade.

decisions.decision: Real image provenance/cache policy bug. Base images must pull from the deployment registry/mirror, not implicit public/default registries.
decisions.fix_direction: Require explicit approved registry references for base images, aligned with the deployment-local registry/cache policy; reject implicit registry references such as team/image:tag or library/python:tag.

decisions.decision: Real Redis completion contract bug. verdict is required to be valid JSON, but validation accepts arbitrary non-JSON strings.
decisions.fix_direction: Parse verdict during validation and reject invalid JSON strings while accepting representative structured JSON verdicts.

decisions.decision: Real gateway readiness robustness bug. Timeout handling can call a missing shutdown callback and throw TypeError.
decisions.fix_direction: Make shutdown required or provide guarded default shutdown behavior for controlled gateway failure handling.

decisions.decision: Real telemetry identity bug. Payload fields can override authoritative event identity.
decisions.fix_direction: Treat runtime/options identity and eventType as authoritative; strip reserved envelope keys or write canonical fields last.

decisions.decision: Real notification correlation bug. Discord observer drops correlation metadata before delivery.
decisions.fix_direction: Forward input.ids as opts.correlation for discord and discordEmbeds delivery.

decisions.decision: Real failure-classification robustness bug. Non-object pre-test verdicts can crash classification/presentation.
decisions.fix_direction: Validate parsed verdict shape and default to { suites: {} } on malformed/non-object values.

decisions.decision: Real cross-sink status bug. Gateway injection success can be overwritten by Discord notification failure.
decisions.fix_direction: Separate gateway delivery status from Discord notification degradation.

decisions.decision: Real rate-limit finalization bug. A failing beforeReturn hook can suppress gate-failure telemetry.
decisions.fix_direction: Isolate custom beforeReturn failures and always run gate-failure telemetry in a separate/finally path.

decisions.decision: Real durable cooldown budget bug. Replay does not extend/pass the run budget consistently.
decisions.fix_direction: Add budget handling to resumeDurableCooldownForStep and pass the budget through sleep calls.

decisions.decision: Real rate-limit telemetry delivery bug. Exhaustion telemetry is fired without returning promises.
decisions.fix_direction: Return or await telemetry promises from rate-limit exhaustion finalizers and record delivery failures.

decisions.decision: Real suite timeout bug. Synchronous suite work cannot be interrupted by the runner timeout.
decisions.fix_direction: Use async abortable subprocesses or killable worker/child process execution, capped by suite timeout.

decisions.decision: Real suite artifact data-loss bug. Shared result/report paths can be overwritten across module runs.
decisions.fix_direction: Namespace artifacts by module/run/attempt and use per-run scratch paths.

decisions.decision: Real suite logging data-loss bug. JSONL logs can be dropped when the tests log directory is new.
decisions.fix_direction: Create results/log directories before constructing log sinks.

decisions.decision: Real visual-reg contract bug. Optional Discord media capability can block visual validation.
decisions.fix_direction: Treat Discord media delivery as noncritical/skipped and continue visual comparison.

decisions.decision: Real manifest parsing bug. Multi-document Kubernetes YAML can be ignored after the first document.
decisions.fix_direction: Parse all YAML documents and select supported workload documents for validation.

decisions.decision: Real CLI output data-loss risk, same class as medium #11 but specific to Nova Redis tool.
decisions.fix_direction: Fix with the same process-exit/stdout-drain handling as the broader CLI truncation issue.

decisions.decision: Real serialization data-loss bug. Repeated array references are incorrectly marked circular.
decisions.fix_direction: Balance seen.add/delete for arrays, ideally with try/finally, while preserving true cycle detection.

decisions.decision: Real shell-command rendering bug. Resume commands interpolate project names without shell escaping.
decisions.fix_direction: Shell-quote every dynamic arg or render argv-style commands through a safe command formatter.

decisions.decision: Real concurrency bug. Shared visual-reg log sink state can attribute one run's logs to another concurrent run.
decisions.fix_direction: Make visual-reg logging per-run by capturing ctx.logSink in a closure and passing that logger into helpers instead of using shared mutable state.

decisions.decision: Real machine-output correctness bug. Case-study summaries can report incorrect code file and duration metrics.
decisions.fix_direction: Use the actual code.codeFiles count and compute duration_seconds from normalized test duration data.

decisions.decision: Real machine-output contract bug. Redis send CLI stdout is not clean JSON because a human log is printed before the JSON result.
decisions.fix_direction: Move diagnostics to stderr or add a quiet/machine mode so stdout contains exactly one parseable JSON document.

decisions.decision: Real documented contract bug. REPO_ROOT is advertised as a fallback but ignored by CLI flag normalization.
decisions.fix_direction: Set repo from rawFlags.repo || env.REPO_ROOT and add a normalization regression test.

decisions.decision: Real lifecycle safety bug. Startup cleanup failures are ignored before the worker advertises readiness.
decisions.fix_direction: Treat failed startup cleanup like failed shutdown cleanup: emit diagnostics and fail closed or stop before readiness/polling.

decisions.decision: Real filesystem-boundary bug. Capability alerts can write to unscoped context-derived paths outside the intended repo/log root.
decisions.fix_direction: Resolve alert targets through scoped path helpers or a repo/log-root allowlist; reject absolute paths and parent traversal.

decisions.decision: Real Discord reliability bug. Message fetch 429s abort purge instead of honoring retry_after.
decisions.fix_direction: Handle fetch 429 before generic failure, parse retry_after, sleep, and retry the fetch loop.

decisions.decision: Real integration contract bug. loadConfig returns a plugin registry but the config API cannot consistently resolve it from loaded.config.
decisions.fix_direction: Bind the startup registry onto loaded config or make pipeline context consistently expose the loaded registry.

decisions.decision: Real dependency-check bug. Gate dependencies can crash when progress.gates is omitted.
decisions.fix_direction: Validate gate dependencies against defined gates or safely return unmet dependency when progress.gates is absent.

decisions.decision: Real prompt contract bug. Review fix prompt returns a raw prompt instead of the structured prompt result contract.
decisions.fix_direction: Return makePromptResult with review-fix phase metadata, module/gate id, attempt, and toString compatibility.

decisions.decision: Real typed contract mismatch. Module runners can reject contract-valid typed pass results unless legacy metadata is also present.
decisions.fix_direction: Either validate the extra runner metadata during normalization or update runners to consume canonical typed worker fields directly.

decisions.decision: Real run-scoping bug. Scheduled validator completion cache can leak completion state across run ids.
decisions.fix_direction: Key validator completion cache by run id or completion path, or reset it when the resolved run id/path changes.

decisions.decision: Real remediation lifecycle bug. Re-review infrastructure errors can consume Forge fix cycles; infrastructure errors should become BLOCKED.
decisions.fix_direction: Only request Forge fix after a validated NO-GO review. Re-review setup/spawn/polling/publication errors should return BLOCKED with infrastructure metadata.

decisions.decision: Real session cleanup bug. Forge fix agents can be left running when polling or transcript handling throws.
decisions.fix_direction: Wrap polling/transcript handling in try/finally and always best-effort kill/clear the gate session.

decisions.decision: Real telemetry/control-flow mismatch. Auto-continue approval timeouts emit failure telemetry while returning pass.
decisions.fix_direction: Emit pass/continued telemetry for CONTINUE timeout policy and failure telemetry only for BLOCK.

decisions.decision: Real telemetry contract mismatch. Telemetry sink builder can produce inputs its own validator rejects.
decisions.fix_direction: Make builder and validator agree by stripping unsupported embeds during normalization or rejecting embeds at builder boundary.

decisions.decision: Real timeout bug. Discord webhook timeout is disabled when a caller AbortSignal is supplied.
decisions.fix_direction: Compose caller signal and timeout signal so timeoutMs is enforced even with options.signal.

decisions.decision: Real rate-limit recovery bug. Liveness probes can overwrite configured gateway credentials with null.
decisions.fix_direction: Only override acpMonitorConfig gateway credentials when top-level values are non-empty.

decisions.decision: Real telemetry redaction bug. Degraded telemetry artifact mirrors can bypass redaction and leak secret-like values.
decisions.fix_direction: Build one sanitized degraded envelope and use it for every artifact and Redis degraded path.

decisions.decision: Real telemetry restoration bug. Redis degradation can be marked restored before Redis records the restored event.
decisions.fix_direction: Reset health only after restored event write succeeds, or keep pending-restore state and retry until committed.

decisions.decision: Real review publication ordering bug. Review output can be published before validation and before canonical gate output is copied.
decisions.fix_direction: Parse and validate reviewer output first, copy canonical gate output before publication, then commit/push validated reviewer and merged gate output together.

decisions.decision: Real async API shape bug. isSessionTerminal has a Promise-returning label path that can be misused as a truthy sync value.
decisions.fix_direction: Make the API consistently async or split synchronous state predicates from asynchronous monitor lookup.

decisions.decision: Real notification delivery bug. Redis CLI can exit before Discord notification promises settle, causing dropped sends or unhandled rejections.
decisions.fix_direction: Await Discord send inside try/catch, catch delayed rejections, and keep Discord delivery noncritical but observed.

decisions.decision: Real durable cooldown bug. Invalid serialized resume_at values can bypass cooldown protection.
decisions.fix_direction: Parse resume_at strictly, require a finite timestamp/date, and keep cooldown open with operator alert on invalid persisted data.

decisions.decision: Real shutdown race. Observability ingester stop can return while an in-flight start loop creates a new Redis client.
decisions.fix_direction: Track and await the loop promise during stop, or add closing state that prevents new Redis clients after shutdown begins.

decisions.decision: Real timeout configuration bug. Default Redis command timeout can race the blocking read timeout and classify idle polls as command failures.
decisions.fix_direction: Make blocking-read command timeout exceed pollBlockMs by a cushion and validate incompatible timeout configs.

decisions.decision: Real authority/ignore-rule bug, adjusted by reviewer guidance. status.json-style authority must be removed from code completely because pipeline-owned authority is the only accepted source of truth; basename ignores must not hide legitimate repo changes.
decisions.fix_direction: Remove status.json-style authority from the codebase entirely and route authority through pipeline-owned state only. Then restrict any remaining runtime/control ignore rules to actual pipeline-owned locations so arbitrary repo files named status.json are still counted as meaningful changes.

decisions.decision: Real approval signal bug. emitExisting can turn an absent approval state file into a fatal signal.
decisions.fix_direction: Treat ENOENT as pending/absent and reserve fatal signals for corrupted or unreadable files that actually exist.

decisions.decision: Real alert-gating bug. discordEmbeds can bypass configured level-based Discord alert gating.
decisions.fix_direction: Apply the same level gate in discordEmbeds before webhook delivery, while keeping audit behavior separate if needed.

decisions.decision: Real git verification bug. Git sync verifies/stores shortened hash instead of comparing full actual HEAD to requested commit.
decisions.fix_direction: Resolve full HEAD after reset, compare to full target hash, and keep shortened hashes only for display.

decisions.decision: Real timeout classification bug. Timeout monitor results can be republished as non-timeout agent outcomes.
decisions.fix_direction: Normalize hard-deadline monitor reasons to explicit TIMEOUT outcomes while preserving monitor reason details.

decisions.decision: Real truth-drift bug. Malformed completion entries with missing status can be skipped instead of reported as drift.
decisions.fix_direction: Adjudicate whenever Redis completion evidence exists, or emit explicit malformed-completion drift for missing/empty/null status.

decisions.decision: Real rate-limit identity bug. Tracked gate identity is not used when raw poll opts omit gate id.
decisions.fix_direction: Build rate-limit identity from resolved telemetry/tracked identity, preserving gate id and gate type.

decisions.decision: Real lifecycle metadata bug. Generic poller drops rate-limit lifecycle mutation metadata.
decisions.fix_direction: Preserve lifecycleMutation through PollResult wrapping or require rate-limit checks to return full result objects.

decisions.decision: Real timeout evidence bug. Session timeout can report no changes even after observed work.
decisions.fix_direction: On timeout, perform final HEAD/worktree signature check and return hasChanges true when work was observed.

decisions.decision: Real active-session race. Cleanup for an old gate session can delete a newer session record.
decisions.fix_direction: Make cleanup identity-aware and unlink only when stored strong identity matches the session being cleared.

decisions.decision: Real failure-handling bug. Unknown Buster poll failures can build an invalid control result and throw; unknown infrastructure/poll failures should become BLOCKED.
decisions.fix_direction: Assign fallback failures a non-null failure class such as unclassified_failure and return a typed BLOCKED/error result.

decisions.decision: Real audit durability bug. One failed Discord audit target can prevent writes to remaining targets.
decisions.fix_direction: Handle append failures per target, continue writing remaining targets, and report failed targets after the loop.

decisions.decision: Real wait lifecycle bug. Gate wait refs ignore attempt and collapse retries through shared idempotency keys.
decisions.fix_direction: Include attempt in wait_ref/resume_signal_ref/idempotency keys or make waits explicitly single-shot.

decisions.decision: Real Kubernetes test bug. Namespace construction uses unsanitized project names.
decisions.fix_direction: Normalize project segment to lowercase DNS-safe label, collapse invalid chars, trim hyphens, and enforce Kubernetes length limits.

decisions.decision: Real secret reference bug. Build secret injection can satisfy a secretKeyRef from the wrong Secret.
decisions.fix_direction: Validate provided Secret metadata.name against secretKeyRef.name or support an explicit Secret map and fail unmatched refs.

decisions.decision: Real API suite templating bug. Default API headers are not interpolated or checked for missing template variables.
decisions.fix_direction: Interpolate defaults.headers with auth variables and include them in missing-template validation.

decisions.decision: Real concurrent artifact bug. Lighthouse reports can be corrupted by concurrent perf suites sharing scratch paths.
decisions.fix_direction: Use per-run scratch paths under testsLogDir or mkdtemp and clean stale scratch before each Lighthouse run.
